title: Tourism opportunities in Odisha
intro: A meeting ends. A free afternoon begins. There could be a museum object you remember, a craft you learn to recognise, or a meal that makes you want to stay another day.
purpose: For organisers, local enterprises and curious visitors: begin with useful knowledge, understand the official guidance, and help a thoughtful idea take shape.

guidance.title: Events and destination weddings
guidance.summary: Start here when researching support for meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions (MICE), or destination weddings. Read the event-specific rules before making financial commitments.
guidance.locator: Pages 3–5, sections 5–11; application and claim annexures on pages 7–11.
guidance.review_extent: All 11 pages reviewed on 5 October; the document was unchanged in a byte comparison on 8 October 2026.
guidance.limit: Application route not yet verified. We have not established whether applications are currently being accepted.

guidance.title: Investment in tourism projects
guidance.summary: A separate set of rules concerns capital investment in eligible tourism units. Use it to frame questions about a proposed project; an event, cultural visit or research activity is not automatically a capital project.
guidance.locator: Pages 1 and 3–5 of 30; sections 8 and 10 address claims and scrutiny.
guidance.review_extent: Only pages 1 and 3–5 reviewed on 5 October; the document was unchanged in a byte comparison on 8 October 2026. Remaining pages and annexures have not been reviewed.
guidance.limit: Partial document review; application route not yet verified. Check all conditions and current instructions with the department; we do not determine your eligibility or submit applications.

reading.title: Bhubaneswar · Objects and Ideas
reading.description: Follow a museum object, a message in stone and a meal. Begin with one question, then let the city widen it.

reading.title: Cuttack · River and Silver
reading.description: A museum courtyard opens a river story. Fine wire brings the scale back to the hand. Leave room for both.

reading.title: Puri · Craft Connections
reading.description: Look beyond a finished object: explore the craft stories and questions that can make a visit more attentive.
